messages:
maria.f: Heads up — found a double-application of the committed capacity credit on ACME Corp invoices for Feb. Looks like both the prepay offset and the monthly commit credit were applied. Need to reverse the revenue recognition and update the deferral schedule before close.

sam.r: Ugh. Which invoice IDs and amounts?

maria.f: INV-2026-0217 (customer ACME), total credit applied = $42,500. Invoice lines show: service revenue line (GL 4100) recognized, then a negative charge for commit credit (GL 6100?) and another negative for prepay credit applied at invoice generation.

liam.b: I can dig in billing. Preliminary: looks like pricing-experiment tag `commit-v2` and `prepay-apply` both matched for the same customer because of overlapping rule priority. I'll push a hotfix to rule ordering and patch existing invoices where possible.

maria.f: For accounting-side, propose we do a reversing JE in current period to move the erroneously recognized amount back to deferred revenue (GL 2105) and then schedule proper monthly recognition. Suggested JE:
```
Dr Service Revenue (4100)   $42,500
  Cr Deferred Revenue (2105) $42,500
```
Recognition schedule after fix: spread deferred amount evenly across remaining 3 months of the subscription term (Mar/Apr/May) => $14,166.67/mo.

anya.k: Do we need a credit memo to customer or is internal adjustment sufficient? Also need to know P&L impact for close.

maria.f: Good Q. Since the customer was effectively given two discounts, we should issue a credit memo of $42,500 and apply it. But from a revenue recognition perspective, the revenue already recognized needs to be reversed (to avoid restatement) — so reversing JE in current close is preferable. P&L impact (this period): recognized revenue down $42,500, but we'll reclassify to deferred and then recognize $14,166.67 per month going forward.

carmen: Do we have a $ threshold for approvals? I can sign off on an internal reversal if it's below $50k and there's a supporting ticket from Billing.

liam.b: I'll create a billing ticket and link invoices. Patch ETA: today EOD for rule fix, and invoice actions tomorrow morning. Will also attach the raw invoice export.

sam.r: For journal — can you add the reference to the billing ticket and the invoice export to the JE? We need audit trail. Also include who approved (carmen).

maria.f: Will prepare the JE and attach docs. Draft note for the close pack: "Reverse duplicate committed credit on INV-2026-0217; issue credit memo CM-2026-0041; move $42,500 to deferred revenue; recognize $14,166.67/month Mar-May."

billing-bot: Ticket #BILL-9342 created by liam.b referencing INV-2026-0217 and CM-2026-0041.

anya.k: Confirming — if CAR (controls) OK and Carmen signs off, we won't restate and will keep adjustment in current period. Carmen? :eyes:

carmen: I approve the internal reversal and credit memo approach. I reviewed the billing ticket and the patch plan. Please include a note in the close binder and update the revenue schedules. :+1:

maria.f: Thanks all — I'll file the JE in NetSuite, attach the billing ticket and export, and update the rev schedule spreadsheet. Will ping once done.

liam.b: Patch deployed to pricing rules; will follow up if any other customers affected.

sam.r: Thx — please tag me on the JE once posted so we can include in the month-end variance memo.
